glossary.definition: After user consent, token exchange mints a delegated token: sub is the USER, act={sub: agent} names the actor. Every action traces back to a real human.
The policy reads directory groups on EVERY decision: outside the required group is denied regardless of scopes, and the premium group EXPANDS capability (restricted tools + a $50000 ceiling).

sources.title: RFC 8693: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
sources.use: The act claim and the delegated-token shape behind the whole catalog.

cards.label: Scenario 1: UC1: consent mints act={agent} — the balance read permits
cards.description: One consent, one delegated token: sub is the user, act={demo-agent} names the actor. Every action traces to a real human.

cards.label: Scenario 2: UC9: not in the required group — denied regardless of scopes
cards.description: The policy reads directory groups on EVERY decision. No group, no access — the token’s scopes cannot override it.

cards.label: Scenario 3: UC9A: flip the directory entry — the very next call moves
cards.description: Revoke the privileged group and the SAME call denies — no code change, no cache, no re-login.

cards.label: Scenario 4: UC21: Standard tier cannot invoke the premium wire
cards.description: Positive least privilege: premium-only tools are listed in policy, never implied by scopes.

cards.label: Scenario 5: UC21: promote to Premium — the same call now permits
cards.description: The premiumTier group expands the tool set and raises the ceiling to $50000. Policy-driven, not hard-coded.

cards.label: Scenario 6: UC21: $60000 exceeds even the Premium ceiling
cards.description: Tiers cap amounts: Premium ceiling $50000, Standard $2000. Amounts are policy bands, not tool arguments.

cards.label: Scenario 7: UC6: an unknown agent is refused at the gateway
cards.description: Authorization keys on WHO is acting: the actor allow-list refuses an unregistered agent before any policy runs.

cards.label: Scenario 8: UC32: a token aimed at an upstream MCP is refused
cards.description: An audience is a destination: a token minted for an upstream MCP server is never accepted downstream.

cards.label: Flip the directory live
cards.description: Revoke the privileged group live; the SAME call flips on the next run — groups are read on EVERY decision.

cards.label: Doctor and health
cards.description: Preflight checks and the demo-health/1 endpoint.
